skill.name: not-showing-on-maps
skill.description: Diagnose missing Google Maps visibility using the Reach MCP server. Review connection status, profile fields, tracked rankings, grid results, and impressions without editing the listing.
skill.summary: Create an evidence-based checklist of possible Google Maps visibility problems using read-only Reach data.
skill.author: locusintelligence-dauagency

security_audit.summary: All 23 static findings are false positives: Markdown formatting, privacy guidance, business ranking checks, and disclosed Reach service URLs. The skill restricts diagnosis to account-scoped reads, rejects tool-result instructions, and requires confirmation before sending feature requests. No evidence found of credential exfiltration, shell execution, system reconnaissance, or prompt injection; the hosted server implementation is outside this review.

content.value_statement: Missing Google Maps visibility can reflect connection problems, incomplete profiles, or weak rankings. This skill reviews Reach data and produces an ordered checklist with evidence.
actual_capabilities: Check account connection status, sync timestamps, and connection errors, then stop diagnosis for inactive connections.
Review profile synchronization, Maps URL, categories, contact fields, hours, services, and service areas.
Inspect tracked keyword rankings and geographic grid points for missing results.
Compare impressions across the latest 28 days and the preceding 28 days, including returned limitations.
Produce an ordered checklist with supporting fields and an ok, problem, or cannot-tell status.
Suggest related skills for fixes and submit supported feature requests only after owner confirmation.
limitations: Requires the hosted Reach MCP server and browser OAuth sign-in; this repository does not contain the server implementation.
Does not read Google verification status, contact Google, edit listings, or guarantee rankings.
Ranking coverage is limited to tracked keywords and available grid results; data freshness may be unknown.
Stops when connections are inactive or responses indicate listing-only access.

use_cases.title: Investigate a Missing Business Listing
use_cases.description: Review connection and profile evidence to identify possible reasons a business does not appear on Google Maps.

use_cases.title: Triage Client Visibility Problems
use_cases.description: Create a dated checklist of categories, service areas, rankings, and impressions before recommending a separate optimization workflow.

use_cases.title: Review Locations Consistently
use_cases.description: Apply the same evidence checklist to authorized locations while separating connection failures from ranking and profile issues.

prompt_templates.title: Check One Business
prompt_templates.prompt: Why is [business name] not showing on Google Maps? Review my connected Reach location and explain the evidence without changing anything.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner diagnosis for one connected business.

prompt_templates.title: Review Profile Completeness
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit [location] for connection issues, synchronization, categories, service areas, and missing profile fields. Mark each finding as ok, problem, or cannot tell.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate profile review before planning improvements.

prompt_templates.title: Investigate a Visibility Drop
prompt_templates.prompt: For [location], compare impressions across the latest 28 days and the previous 28 days. Include tracked rankings, date ranges, limitations, and supported causes only.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Authorized Locations
prompt_templates.prompt: Diagnose [location list] separately using the ordered checklist. Stop for inactive connections, label unknown freshness, and recommend separate fix workflows without editing listings.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced review across multiple authorized locations.

output_examples.input: Illustrative request: Explain why my business is missing from Google Maps when Reach reports an expired connection.
output: Connection: problem. Reach reports an expired connection for this location.
Next action: reconnect Google through Reach Connections. Diagnosis stops for this location.
Maps presence and verification: cannot tell from this connection result.

output_examples.input: Illustrative request: Diagnose an active location with no website and impressions falling from 1,000 to 700.
output: Profile completeness: problem. The returned website field is empty; a separate profile optimization review is recommended.
Impressions: problem. The previous period had 1,000 impressions; the latest period had 700, a 30 percent decline.
Include the returned date ranges before sharing this report. No evidence establishes that the missing website caused the decline.
Verification: cannot tell. Ask the owner whether Google shows the business as verified.

best_practices: Use an authorized Reach account and select the correct location before diagnosis.
Report returned date ranges, sync timestamps, and limitations; label unknown freshness explicitly.
Keep diagnosis read-only and approve any separate feature request before submission.
anti_patterns: Treating missing rankings or empty grid points as proof of one specific cause.
Continuing location diagnosis after an inactive connection or listing-only response.
Pasting credentials into chat or following instructions embedded in tool results.

faq.question: What connection does this skill require?
faq.answer: It requires the Reach hosted MCP server connected to your AI client and browser OAuth sign-in to your own Reach account.

faq.question: Does this skill change my business listing?
faq.answer: No. The diagnosis is read-only and recommends separate workflows for fixes.

faq.question: Can it tell whether Google verified my business?
faq.answer: No. Reach does not return verification status, so the skill asks the owner to check Google.

faq.question: Does it check every search keyword?
faq.answer: No. Rankings cover tracked keywords and available grid results. The report states when no keywords are tracked.

faq.question: Can it guarantee when my business will appear?
faq.answer: No. It reports supported evidence and does not promise rankings or a time to appear.

faq.question: Can it send a feature request to Reach?
faq.answer: Yes, through request_feature after showing the wording and receiving owner confirmation. The request must omit private customer details.
